entities.summary: Chester Lamar Taylor, nicknamed "Che Tay", is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the sixth round of the 2002 NFL draft. In 2006, he signed with the Minnesota Vikings and played four seasons before signing with the Chicago Bears. He played college football for the Toledo Rockets.
